create_sampleframe_from_dataframe: create a SampleFrame from a pandas DataFrame with auto-detected id, weight, and covariate columns
create_sampleframe_from_sample: create a SampleFrame from an existing Sample object preserving covariates, weights, and outcomes
set_weights_on_sampleframe: set or update the active weight column values on a SampleFrame using a Series or scalar
trim_weights_on_sampleframe: trim extreme weight values on a SampleFrame using a ratio or percentile threshold
add_weight_column_to_sampleframe: add a new weight column to a SampleFrame with optional metadata and set it as active
